'''Aegis of Aaaaarrrrrrggghhh''' is a [[unique item|unique]] [[shield]] dropped by [[The Black Beast of Arrgh]], a [[boss-like foe]] who can be found in the [[Domain of Anguish]].

==Stats==
:[[Armor rating|Armor]]: 16 (Requires 9 [[Tactics]])
:Armor +10 (vs. [[Demon]]s)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This shield uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Aureate Aegis]] [[dye]]d black.

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated, as the +10 armor versus Demons is not an available [[inscription]]. The other (unique) versions of this shield are the:
*[[Aegis of Terror]] [[Strength|(strength)]]
*[[Stygian Defender]] [[Command|(command)]]
*[[Stygian Aegis]] [[Motivation|(motivation)]]

==Trivia==
This item's name was changed with [[Game_updates/20090423#Guild_Wars_Wiki_notes|Thursday, April 23, 2009 update]] from "''Aegis of Augh''" to its current name to more accurately represent the boss it drops from (and its [[Touch of Aaaaarrrrrrggghhh|signature skill]]).
